rules.family: max one affix per family per item
rules.rolling: filter by slot + ilvl_req, then weighted pick by weight; roll value uniformly in [roll_min, roll_max]; damage_flat_* rolls (min,max) pair inside the range
rules.tiers: T5 worst -> T1 best; higher ilvl unlocks better tiers but keeps lower ones in the pool

meta.note: v3 idle rework: removed stun/block/armor_pen/shock_effect/ailment-chance/low-life/burning/projectile families; added area/boss/global damage, cooldown recovery, experience gained. Replaces affixes_v2.json.
